case.summary: The alert was triggered when the real-time model scored online transaction 3478782 for $292.36 on card C11891-K1 with a risk score of 0.79. The only notable activity is this single online purchase of product C, which is inconsistent with the cardholder's typical behavior. The case is deemed uncertain with a fraud probability of 0.53. The recommended actions are to decline the transaction, create a case, continue monitoring the card, and escalate the matter to an analyst.
